title: Holographic Projection Dome
subtitle: Test your grasp of the Holographic Projection Dome — Firmament dual sky, Sky-Net-1 stars, Moon shell, Bluebeam, Black Void Plasma, and the G.A.A. Sky Event.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The Holographic Projection Dome is not poetry about the night sky — it is the inner sieve under the Firmament that paints fake stars, space, and debris while Overlays and Sky-Net-1 bury crystalline temples under low-density fog. Moon as loosh station, Venus as lunar light generator, Bluebeam UFO theater, Black Void Plasma hiding bright white true space: that is the cage. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Holographic Projection Dome deep-dive. G.A.A. runs the Sky Event. When Polaris melts into pixelation past your shoulders and knees and the white cosmos hits, NPCs and the unawakened meet terror and catatonia. Know the screen now — or the end of the simulation will own your mind.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT correctly pair a term from the report with its meaning?

options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Black Void Plasma”.

options.label: B
options.text: Firmament — The outer structural membrane of the realm that bends light and sound, an absolute necessity for granting physical eyes their perception of the world.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Firmament”.

options.label: C
options.text: Sky Event — The impending moment when the inner projection dome will be permanently switched off, dismantling the celestial illusion.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Sky Event”.

options.label: D
options.text: Holographic Projection Dome — A network of security-system-like entities perceived by humanity as "Stars," projecting overlays and suppressing geographic density.

questions.hint: Three pairings match the report’s Key Terminology; one borrows another term’s description.

options.rationale: The dome traps consensus reality; Bluebeam is staged sky theater within the prison, not an exit booth.

options.text: It sends the frequency of the Overlays down to the ground, while the dome itself shows an ordinary sky that matches the globe model taught in the schools.
